ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course for students in the Rockford cohort begins August 26 and ends December 9. Class sessions will be held on Thursdays evening from 6:00 to 8:50 PM. The course content and instruction will be delivered using both the Compass course management system and Elluminate conferencing technology. There will also be one face-to-face class session held at the College of Medicine in Rockford, IL. The date for the face-to-face session is Thursday, August 26. The email address for the instructor is: moorthi2@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $423.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
